hints.title: Circular Monotonic Insertion Point Detection
hints.text: Traverse the circular loop looking for an ordered gap, the boundary turnaround point, or complete circuit traversal.

hints.title: Three Case Traversal Checking
hints.text: Case 1: prev.val <= insertVal <= curr.val. Case 2: prev.val > curr.val (boundary turnaround) and insertVal >= prev.val or insertVal <= curr.val. Case 3: complete loop with all identical values.

hints.title: Circular Insertion Blueprint
hints.text: If head is None: new_node.next = new_node; return new_node. prev, curr = head, head.next. Loop until match found or curr == head: if case 1 or case 2 match: break. Advance pointers. Splice new node between prev and curr.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in circular list
complexity.notes: Traverses at most one full loop of the circular list with constant auxiliary pointers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to handle the circular wrap-around point causes infinite loops or invalid list splices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space utilizing existing list pointers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling the three insertion conditions: between sorted values, at the list wrap-around, and all uniform values.

solutions.approach: C++ Circular Pointer Walk with Wrap Detection
